dataLineage.statement:
Layer was downloaded as a shapefile by ITOS from the UNOCHA COD FOD Registry. It was then analyzed by ITOS for errors. Those errors were corrected and then the layer was sent back to UNOCHA as a feature class within a file geodatabase.
The following errors were found and fixed by ITOS: 1. Created and populated reference name field 2. 10 gap errors and 11 overlap topology errors were fixed on the borders of Warrap
The following errors were found and left as is by ITOS: 1. The Abyei region does not exist in this Admin1 layer and does exist in the Admin2 layer so the two layers do not nest.
